findings.title: Phone Month titles break mid-word
findings.fix: Break at word boundaries within the two-line clamp (overflow-wrap:normal; consider hyphens:auto with the document lang) so words stay whole; verify long single words do not clip without ellipsis.

findings.title: Mixed disabled state in Group calendars access row
findings.evidence: Disabled filled Group select, enabled Role select, ghost Add group; no inline path to create a group.
findings.fix: Disable Role with the same condition as Group (available.length===0) so the row reads as one unavailable state; optionally link 'add a group' in the help line.

findings.title: People row actions heavy (optional, deferred)
findings.evidence: Four outlined 40px buttons per everyday row; Disable wraps alone on phone.
findings.fix: Optional quieter tertiary style for Edit/Reset/Make admin; keep Disable as danger outline and 40px targets.

not_recommended: Changing New event focus or native date controls
Another capture round only to move sub-0.3 calibration differences
Restyling theme cards or the login

independent_satisfaction.reason: Round 3 fixed the header, tall titles, Add group state and the Week paint regression, and desktop now averages 961/120 -> 8.0. Phone Month still reads worse than it should (mid-word breaks, 6.7) and the admin Group calendars row shows mixed states (7.5), so overall is 7.9. Two small, source-located fixes address the substantive remainder; most of the round-2 to round-3 rise is my calibration (+0.24 on byte-identical images), not product change. Separate from the gate.
